actions.newValue: Atwell and Hiddleston may be the draw—and they’re an absolute delight as the bickering Beatrice and Benedick, two self-proclaimed singletons engaged in a long-running battle of wits—but there are abundant pleasures to be found in director Jamie Lloyd’s gloriously giddy pretty-in-hot-pink production.
